changes: Add official Ghidra -noanalysis switch; code/function seeds still run before the bridge.
Apply checked PDB function extents to fix one-instruction exception-directory bodies.
Commit disabled auto-analysis, local patch identifier and range-file SHA-256 into the analysis profile digest.
limitations: Local analysis copy, not the unmodified published release.
Only decoded/seeded instructions and functions contribute references; xrefs are not a whole-game inventory.
PDB extents are caller assertions from the matched build; shared tails/optimized aliases still require interpretation.
No full Ghidra type inference, stack-variable, string, switch or external-call analysis. Pseudocode must be checked against PDB ranges and disassembly.
